resources.string: We will email you a link to reset your password.
You sign in with your phone number, so there is no password to change.
You have not saved any vouchers yet.
You have no reminders yet. Tap "Remind me" on a coming-soon movie.
Pay with a QR code, a domestic ATM card or a Visa / Mastercard through VNPay.
CETA does not store your card details. You enter payment details directly on VNPay.
More payment methods are coming soon.
Pick a movie, a showtime and your seats, add snacks if you like, then pay with VNPay. Your tickets appear in My tickets right away.
Seats are held for 10 minutes once you continue from the seat map. If you have not paid by then, they go back on sale.
I paid but see no ticket?
Tickets appear once VNPay confirms the payment, usually within seconds. If yours has not, open Transactions to see the status of your order.
You earn 1 point for every 1,000đ paid. Every 2,000 points are worth 20,000đ at checkout, when the order is large enough.
Where do I use a voucher?
Save the code in Offers or type it at checkout. One voucher per order, taken off the ticket price.
How do I get into the cinema?
Show the QR code in My tickets to the staff at the door. Turn the screen brightness up so it scans faster.
Sign in again to confirm, then try deleting your account once more.

Your account, CETA points, saved vouchers and reminders will be deleted for good and cannot be restored. Your booking history is kept for the records but is no longer linked to you.\n\nIf you still have unused tickets, watch the movie or cancel them first.
To confirm it is you, sign in once more.
Sign out, sign in again, then try deleting your account.
